relations.quote: The recursion is built on the [Three-element subset intersection construction](subset-intersection-construction.md), which gives $s<Wm$ smaller calls.

symbols.name: call parameter
symbols.meaning: The parameter of a call; it counts field digits for address interchange and selected axes for a numerical layer.
symbols.quote: Let $f$ be the parameter of a call; it counts field digits for address interchange and selected axes for a numerical layer.

symbols.name: stored bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits in the array a call works on.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored bit volume.

symbols.name: parameter multiplier
symbols.meaning: The factor by which a recursive call multiplies the parameter.
symbols.quote: A recursive call at parameter $mf$ makes $s$ subcalls at parameter $f$, each on a stream of volume $V/W$, where $m$ is the factor by which the parameter is multiplied, $s$ is the number of subcalls, and $W$ is the divisor of the volume.

symbols.name: subcall count
symbols.meaning: The number of subcalls a recursive call makes.
symbols.quote: A recursive call at parameter $mf$ makes $s$ subcalls at parameter $f$, each on a stream of volume $V/W$, where $m$ is the factor by which the parameter is multiplied, $s$ is the number of subcalls, and $W$ is the divisor of the volume.

symbols.name: volume divisor
symbols.meaning: The divisor by which each subcall reduces the stream volume from $V$ to $V/W$.
symbols.quote: A recursive call at parameter $mf$ makes $s$ subcalls at parameter $f$, each on a stream of volume $V/W$, where $m$ is the factor by which the parameter is multiplied, $s$ is the number of subcalls, and $W$ is the divisor of the volume.

symbols.name: normalized cost
symbols.meaning: The cost of a call at parameter $f$ divided by the volume $V$ it works on.
symbols.quote: Let $T(f)$ be the cost of a call at parameter $f$ divided by the volume $V$ it works on.
